problem_statement: Thread Direct lacks a periodic radio availability schedule representation. A node needs to define a periodic availability schedule from a bitmap (with slot durations of 625 µs or 1250 µs, a start time, and a maximum bitmap size of 12 bytes / 96 bits) and query it: whether the radio is available at a given time, whether the radio is continuously available throughout a given window, and what the next contiguous available window starting from a given time is. The schedule must support initialization, clearing, and querying across slot boundaries with wrap-around, and return kErrorNotFound when no slot is available.
